author: Snailmeister24
quote:
I can’t believe people had to wait so long for this disappointment ****. GTA VI is not only a straight up bore with awkward gameplay mechanics and performance issues, but it has been sapped of the humor and absurdity that made the games reprehensible material so palatable throughout the years. 

GTA 5 worked so well because the designers had a pitch perfect sense of satire, and the intuition to present some of the series most repulsive characters in a way that commented on the relationship with the player and the franchises core gameplay loop at meta scale. It was also just straight up funny (can’t say that for this game). 

GTA VI in contrast feels like it was put together by sociopaths; One minute you are forced to engage with the games “mature relationship narrative” (who wants this in a GTA game?)  and the next you are dismembering an innocent civilian with a shotgun in graphic detail. It doesn’t help that Jason has no personality or character at all. 

Also, it’s sad to see this game getting praised for its graphics and detail, as if that is the deciding barometer to determine a games greatness at all. Honestly, I think you will have a better time downloading **** for free and hopping on Banana Eats or something.
